instruction: Add two text plugins: `upper` (upper-cases the text) and `reverse` (reverses it). Each is a module in plugins/ with a `run(text)` function, listed in registry.py like `strip`, so that `python3 main.py upper hello` prints HELLO and `python3 main.py reverse hello` prints olleh. Have two sub-agents write them at the same time, one plugin each, each isolated in its own worktree, then bring both changes into this working tree: both edit registry.py.
